description: Newcomers nobody has answered: introductions from the last month and first posts from the last two weeks that nobody outside their own household has answered, oldest first. A later post counts as an answer only if it replies to the newcomer or names them. Two tiers: no reply anywhere, and greeted in the guestbook but not yet answered in the thread. Each row carries what one reply needs: the discussion to post in, the opener post to reply to, and the voice to greet. An empty list means everyone has been met.
name: welcome_queue
